scores.rationale: Pinned version-three contract, baseline, donor decisions, and candidate scope are present and reproducible.
Baseline records complete repository checks passing and preserves canonical lifecycle controls.
Agency relations classify the proof set with bounded actions, collective-credit boundaries, support states, and anti-claims.
The frozen contract defines append-safe intake, bounded query, reporting, and leak controls; permitted evidence shows the validation contract but not command transcripts.
Survivorship statuses, bounded non-recovery language, separated rights dimensions, and re-entry rules are explicit.
Composition manifest specifies route arguments, budgets, selections, omissions, and mosaic privacy decisions.
This receipt independently binds the frozen contract and candidate fingerprints and follows the read-only holdout role; receipt-level trust is scored without asserting unseen-receipt completion.
The baseline records passing source, graph, runtime, build, public-safety, and route checks, with staging/indexing controls retained.
Human release and launch gates remain explicitly pending and are not represented as automated approval.
